name: The Fruitist
note: Official sleeve-patch partner of D.C. United since 2024 (club announcement, Feb 23, 2024). Owner Agrovision Corp. renamed itself Fruitist in 2025. Founder-led, investor-backed US company (Aliment Capital led a 2024 growth investment per the company's release); no state ownership and no human-rights finding against the company found.
